question: Rural Employment Generation Programme (REGP) was launched in _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1995**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On 1st April 1995, the Khadi & Village Industries Commission (KVIC) launched the Rural Employment Generation Programme (REGP) scheme.
 
• The scheme generated job opportunities for around two million job seekers under the Khadi and Village Industries sector in the rural areas of the country.
 
• It is a credit-linked subsidiary scheme.
 
• It is a central sector scheme administered by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises.
 
• Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) has been announced on 15th August 2008 and launched in place of REGP Scheme.
 
• PMEGP is a credit-linked subsidy programme launched by Ministry of MSME in 2008-09 for creation of employment in both rural and urban area of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Khadi and Village Industries Commission is a statutory organization.
 
• It was formed in April 1957 by the Government of India, under the 'Khadi and Village Industries Commission Act of 1956'.
